title: Choose the visual world
question: Round 2 after two consecutive re-rolls. Your Pinterest steer (pixel windows, grimy skins, IMAGE on the field) is on the table as IMPECCABLE’S PICK — a skinned player. THE ROLL is still City Desk, leftover from the original list and the least like the pins. Cutting-bench was dealt and dropped as a reword of Film Trim Bin (already shown). Waiting in the pool: pixel overlapping-windows, photographic contact sheet, silkscreen poster rack, hardware faceplate, graphic zigzag field. After two re-rolls I need the missing quality in one line: graphic skin on the field, IMAGE as material, overlapping windows, or something else? Lock a card, or re-roll with that quality named.

options.label: City Desk Spike
options.lineage: newsroom copy spike, torn slugs, morgue drawers
options.thesis: Jobs are copy slugs on a metal spike. HIT pulls one slug onto the folio as writable paper.
options.viewport: Cream desk. Spike at left with impaled slugs. HIT opens SITE REDESIGN as a folio sheet with boxed nested lines. FIND is the morgue. Stems stay the catalogue under the desk.
options.risk: Reads as a newspaper CMS, or as kanban if the gutters become card columns.

raised.raise: State is a mark on the slug — strike, stamp, fold — never a hue wash.
Spike order is the only ranking axis; nothing reranks by color or size.
Copy on the spike is the only display. No icons, no pictograms.

options.label: Skinned Player
options.lineage: Winamp TRIO grimy metal player skin, playlist as the listing
options.thesis: The studio is one skinned chassis. The LCD is the folio. The playlist is the TUI catalogue.
options.viewport: Putty-metal player filling the sheet. LCD reads SITE REDESIGN. Playlist is red-on-black stems. HIT is a stamped transport key. FIND is a recessed field. Nested work sits as inset plates, never stems on the chassis.
options.risk: The category default for a skin, and it collapses into a cassette or a 3D-knob deck if the chassis becomes a toy.

options.label: Boarding Pass + Gate Board
options.lineage: segmented boarding pass with a live departure board
options.thesis: The folio is the pass. The rack is a gate board whose rows rerank in place.
options.viewport: Pass across the top for SITE REDESIGN. Gate board ranks jobs as full-width rows, not cards. The live row holds alert red. FIND is a scan field. Stems never print on the pass.
options.case: Holds product clarity: HIT is entering the pass, ON is a row climbing the board. Identification is airport, not a making desk.
options.risk: Reads as a travel app, or as kanban if rows become cards.

options.label: Festival Lineup Sheet
options.lineage: one-face festival billing poster, rank by type size only
options.thesis: Jobs are names on a billing sheet. HIT inverts the headliner into the writing surface.
options.viewport: Black field. SITE REDESIGN spans as the headliner. Nested work is the next size down. Status is billing blocks, not columns. FIND inverts. Stems are the smallest justified block at the foot.
options.case: Holds identification: you can read rank from across the room. Clarity slips if size is the only status and the folio has no writing well.
options.risk: Reads as a concert poster, or as a type specimen with no place to work.

options.label: Arcade Pixel Grid
options.lineage: 240-line arcade cabinet, integer tiles, phosphor bloom
options.thesis: The studio as a sprite stage on a tile grid.
options.viewport: Tile playfield. Jobs as sprites. Status as palette laws.
options.case: Loses both axes: CRT clothes are vetoed, and a sprite stage hides the folio as a document.
options.kept: State is a mark, not a hue.
options.risk: Costume cockpit. Product veto on CRT wells.

options.label: Mesophotic Dive
options.lineage: vertical wall dive, thermocline, marine snow
options.thesis: Work as a descent down one depth axis.
options.viewport: A vertical depth profile with jobs pinned to meters.
options.case: Loses both axes: not a making desk, and depth hides HIT as entering a document.
options.kept: One ranking axis owns the sheet.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.lineage: letters as weather that reshape the ground
options.thesis: Jobs condense from weather-type and break back into weather.
options.viewport: An open field of letter-weather with no desk.
options.case: Loses both axes: surreal, and it cannot host a writable folio.
options.kept: Type is the only display. No icons.

canonCard.label: Linear-class board
canonCard.thesis: The category standard, played at Linear, Things, and Height craft. Status columns, cards, filters, a detail drawer.
canonCard.viewport: Five columns PENDING · R&D · ACTIVE · DONE · DUSTED. Search in the header. Select a card, a drawer opens. No costume.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Linear by design — that is the point of this door.
